Question 5
?

Find the fundamental vector product of the surface defined by the equations

x=u2+1,y=v3+1,z=2u+v.

a
⟨v,−2u,−3uv2⟩
b
⟨v2−u,2v,uv2⟩
c
 ⟨u−v,2u,v2−u⟩
d
⟨−6v2+u,−2u+v,6uv2⟩
e
⟨−6v2,−2u,6uv2⟩
